tests: with the highlight moved to Open by Tab, Enter runs the open twice
with the highlight moved to Browse... by Tab, Enter opens the picker and the selected item
with the highlight moved to Cancel by Tab, Enter closes a saved project with no question and opens the selected card
Enter on a focused card opens the selected card, not the focused one
steps:
1. Open a saved project and change nothing.
2. File > New Project...
3. Press Tab four times: the highlight is on Cancel.
4. Press Enter: the project closes with no question, and New Project Options opens for the selected card.
With Tab pressed three times the highlight is on Open, and Enter runs the open twice; with two, on Browse..., and Enter shows the picker and opens the item.
For the card: click ActiveX DLL, click in the search box, press Tab (the focus is on Standard EXE), press Enter: ActiveX DLL opens.
Control: Esc, and a click on Cancel, keep the project.
